name: Bailiff Conacher
summary: In Lakeshire Town Hall, Bailiff Conacher keeps Stormwind law in force under Magistrate Solomon. He relies on travelers to uphold local decrees across the embattled Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: Justice in Lakeshire
sections.body: Bailiff Conacher works with Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire Town Hall to uphold law across the Redridge Mountains. Blackrock orcs and local gnolls besiege the town, leaving Conacher without ordinary civic procedures or royal garrisons to rely on. He issues legal decrees that authorize passing travelers to carry out capital justice in the realm's name.

sections.title: Applying Solomon's Law
sections.body: When the dark mage Morganth took the Tower of Ilgalar and bent the local Shadowhide gnolls to his will, the Court of Lakeshire judged the beasts guilty of high treason. Stormwind law sentences those who aid a fugitive and criminal to death. Conacher invokes Solomon's Law and sends travelers across the ridges to find Shadowhide gnolls and bring back their pendants as proof that the crown's law has been carried out.

faq.answer: Bailiff Conacher serves the Court of Lakeshire and helps Magistrate Solomon uphold civil authority and Stormwind law in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Where can Bailiff Conacher be found?
faq.answer: You can find Bailiff Conacher inside Lakeshire Town Hall, on the north side of the bridge in the Redridge Mountains.

Solomon's Law applies Stormwind law by decree of Magistrate Solomon. Aiding known criminals such as the rogue sorcerer Morganth carries a death sentence, making his allied Shadowhide gnolls liable to execution.

faq.q: Why does Conacher ask for Shadowhide pendants?
faq.answer: The pendants prove that a Shadowhide gnoll has been slain under Lakeshire's legal sentence against those aiding Morganth.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see how far Stormwind law reaches in a border town left largely to fend for itself.
